name: Unabyss
description:
Unabyss is a user-owned context layer for AI tools. It connects to the
sources where your context already lives — Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar,
Notion, Slack, GitHub, LinkedIn, X, Obsidian — and extracts a structured
vault covering who you are, what you're working on, and how you communicate.

With the connector enabled, Claude can pull that context at the start of any
conversation instead of you re-explaining your role, company, stack, and
preferences every time.

What you can do:
- Look up specific facts about yourself, your company, or past decisions, and
  ask synthesis questions across your entire context
- Save durable facts, decisions, and preferences back to your vault as they
  come up in conversation
- Load skills — ready-made playbooks for recurring work like daily briefs,
  investor updates, pre-call research, and content drafting
- Generate topic-scoped Markdown exports to reuse in tools that don't
  support MCP
- Connect new sources directly from chat, without leaving the conversation

Your context stays yours. Permissions are granular per tool and per layer
(Identity / Profile / Mind), connected sources keep context self-updating,
and access can be revoked at any time. Unabyss is MCP-native and
cross-platform, so the same vault works in Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and
any other MCP client.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Unabyss to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Unabyss to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.unabyss.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Unabyss MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unabyss lists 17 MCP tools, including agentic_query, agentic_query_read, export_create, export_create_from_text, export_list, export_read, export_refresh, get_skill, list_integrations, list_skills, propose_connection, and query.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Unabyss?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Unabyss in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Unabyss requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Unabyss is developed by Unabyss. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
